title: Dhara Enterprises Invoice + Inventory Management Web App

requirements.text: Implement a username/password login system with role-based permissions, including an initial admin account (username: admin001, password: admin001) and enforcement that only admins can manage users and access admin-only settings.

quotes: 1. yes i want a login system and i want that different users must have different permissions the username for the admin is: admin001 and password is admin001 ... this cvsn be done by the admin only no other user can do this

acceptanceCriteria: User can log in with username/password and remain authenticated across page refresh.
System supports at least roles: Admin and Staff (or equivalent), with UI and backend authorization checks.
Admin-only actions are blocked for non-admin users in both UI (hidden/disabled) and backend (rejected calls).
Initial admin credentials exist as specified and can be changed by an admin from Settings.

requirements.text: Create the top navigation bar and page structure with these sections and dropdowns: Register (Vendor, Customer, User), Inventory (Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Order Book, Ledger), Invoice, Reports, and Settings.

quotes: on the top i want a navbar in which there must be different sections register ... dropdown ... next inventory : in this the dropdown will be as inventory , sales , purchase , order book , ledger ... now next is invoice ... also add one settings component to the nambar

acceptanceCriteria: Navbar renders consistently across authenticated pages.
Register dropdown contains Vendor, Customer, User screens.
Inventory dropdown contains Inventory, Sales, Purchase, Order Book, Ledger screens.
Invoice, Reports, and Settings are accessible as their own sections.
Routes are protected so unauthenticated users cannot access app pages.

requirements.text: Implement Vendor and Customer management: add/register new vendors and customers, list them, and allow deletion from the Register section.

quotes: add new and register new customers and vendors
register : in this the vendor and customer registration will be done and also give a provision to delete them

acceptanceCriteria: User can create a vendor with required identity/contact fields and see it in a searchable/sortable list.
User can create a customer with required identity/contact fields and see it in a searchable/sortable list.
User can delete vendors/customers with confirmation, and deleted entities no longer appear in lists.
Backend persists vendors/customers and enforces authorization.

requirements.text: Implement User management (admin-only): create new users, assign roles/permissions, list users, and delete/disable users from Register > User.

quotes: add new users
we can register a user from here only ... vendor then customer then user
different users must have different permissions

acceptanceCriteria: Only admin can create/update/delete/disable users.
Admin can assign a role/permission set per user.
Non-admin users cannot access user management UI or perform user management backend calls.
Disabled users cannot log in.

requirements.text: Implement Inventory item management: add new stock items, edit them, delete them, and track stock with dates for when items came into inventory and when sold.

quotes: new items can be added and deleted in the stock the date also must be there when the item came in the inventory. and selling date both
in inventory the inventory management will be done

acceptanceCriteria: Inventory items support at least: item code, item name, and current quantity on hand.
System records stock-in (arrival/purchase) date and stock-out (sale) date at the transaction level (not just a single date per item).
User can add/edit/delete items (with safeguards if item has historical transactions).
Low inventory can be derived from quantity and a configurable low-stock threshold per item or global default.

requirements.text: Implement Purchase entry module (Inventory > Purchase): allow recording purchases including vendor, items, quantities, purchase date, and purchase price (cost). Purchases must increase on-hand inventory and be stored for reporting.

quotes: in purchase all the purchase entry will be made

acceptanceCriteria: User can create a purchase record selecting a vendor and adding one or more line items with quantities and cost.
Submitting a purchase increases inventory quantities accordingly.
Purchase records are listed and filterable by date/vendor/item.
Backend persists purchases and inventory changes atomically.

requirements.text: Implement Sales entry module (Inventory > Sales): allow recording sales including customer, items, quantities, sale date, selling price, and delivery person name, and support marking payment status (paid/unpaid/partial). Sales must decrease on-hand inventory and drive pending payment tracking.

quotes: in sales all the sales entry will be made
more info like the delivery person name , whom the product is being delivered to
if the payement is noty done then it should show red color highlighted

acceptanceCriteria: User can create a sale record selecting a customer and adding one or more line items with quantities and selling prices.
Submitting a sale decreases inventory quantities accordingly and records sale date.
Sale can be marked as paid/unpaid/partial with paid amount and due amount computed and stored.
Unpaid/partial entries are visually highlighted in red in relevant lists and have a clear “Pending” status label.

requirements.text: Implement Order Book (Inventory > Order Book): show all orders/items sold with quantity, delivery person name, date, and price; support filtering/searching and status visibility for payment (paid/pending).

quotes: in Order book all the order which items are sold willl be written so that we can check which item is sold the quantity , delivery person name , date , price all this

acceptanceCriteria: Order Book lists sales/orders in a table with required columns (items/qty/date/delivery person/price/payment status).
User can filter by date range, customer, and payment status.
Entries with pending payment are highlighted in red.
Order Book is backed by persisted sales/order data (not just UI state).

requirements.text: Implement Ledger (Inventory > Ledger) that automatically fetches entries from Order Book/Sales and calculates balances, showing a running total and the final positive/negative balance at the bottom; pending payments must be clearly indicated.

quotes: in the ledger it should fetch the entry made in the order book automatically and if the payment is pending it should show the negative or positive balance in the bottom

acceptanceCriteria: Ledger is derived from sales/orders without duplicate manual entry.
Ledger shows per-customer (or overall) outstanding amounts and running balance depending on filters.
Ledger view includes a final balance (positive/negative) at the bottom.
Pending/unpaid amounts are clearly labeled and visually emphasized.

requirements.text: Build the Dashboard home page with: (1) a sales chart, (2) a pending payments list showing amount and person name, and (3) a low-inventory widget showing products low in stock with remaining quantity.

quotes: at the home page it should have a sales chart and a pending payment list which we have to collect with amount and the person name
also add a short box in which there must be shown the product which is low in inventory with the left qty

acceptanceCriteria: Sales chart renders from stored sales data and supports at least a daily view over the recent period (e.g., last 30 days).
Pending payments card lists each pending entry with name and due amount; clicking an entry navigates to its detail (sale/order/ledger).
Low inventory card lists items below threshold with remaining quantity.
All widgets load from backend data and handle empty states gracefully.

requirements.text: Implement Invoice creation and rendering with a properly aligned “original invoice” A5 layout, including: item code, item name, quantity, date, delivery person name, delivered-to customer, and firm details: DHARA ENTERPRISES; phone 9891860870; address C-134A Raju Park Near Sainik Farms Eastern Avenue New Delhi -80; website dharagroups.in; email dharaindiaenterprises@gmail.com.

quotes: generate invoice with proper format like a original invoice the invoice should be in the a5 paper form and must contain all the necessary details like item code , item name , qty , date , more info like the delivery person name , whom the product is being delivered to , our firm name "DHARA ENTERPRISES" contact details : no. 9891860870 , address : C-134A Raju Park Near Sainik Farms Eastern Avenue New Delhi -80 website : dharagroups.in Email : dharaindiaenterprises@gmail.com
in the invoice section everthing should be perfect the alignment must be done properly

acceptanceCriteria: Invoice screen allows selecting/creating an invoice from an order/sale and displays a print-ready A5 layout.
Invoice includes all specified fields and firm contact block exactly as provided.
Line items show item code, item name, qty, and pricing totals.
Layout is visually aligned and readable when printed to A5 (CSS print styles).

requirements.text: Make invoices downloadable as a file (PDF) in A5 size.

quotes: 3. yes also make the invoice downloadable

acceptanceCriteria: User can click a “Download PDF” action on an invoice.
Downloaded PDF uses A5 dimensions and matches the on-screen invoice formatting closely.
Downloaded filename includes invoice number and date (or another deterministic identifier).

requirements.text: Add Paytm UPI QR payment support for invoices: show a scannable QR code that encodes a UPI payment request with the exact invoice total so the payer sees the total amount and can pay that exact amount.

quotes: and a payment scanner after which when someone scan it the total amount of the bill is shown and he or she can make the payment for the exact amount
2. i would like to use Paytm upi qr code for payment

acceptanceCriteria: Invoice view displays a QR code for payment.
QR code encodes a UPI payment link/request including the exact invoice total amount.
If UPI payment configuration is missing, UI shows a clear admin-only prompt to configure it in Settings (without breaking invoice rendering).

requirements.text: Create a Settings section in the navbar with admin-only controls to change user IDs/passwords and manage other core business/payment settings (including Paytm/UPI QR configuration used for invoice QR generation).

quotes: add one settings component to the nambar and let the user change the id password but this cvsn be done by the admin only no other user can do this also add other elements to the settings section

acceptanceCriteria: Settings page is accessible only to admins (non-admins cannot view or call related backend methods).
Admin can change a user’s username and/or password.
Admin can configure the UPI/Paytm QR payment parameters used to generate invoice QR codes.
Settings changes persist and take effect without redeploying.

requirements.text: Implement a simple, premium UI theme using primarily white and black with minimal accent colors, applied consistently across all pages and components.

quotes: 4. i want simple theme only white and premium black you can add some elements in between with other color also but make it simple only

acceptanceCriteria: App uses a consistent white/black dominant theme with restrained accent colors.
Tables, forms, and dashboard cards are readable and visually consistent.
Pending payments and alerts (e.g., low stock) use clear, accessible emphasis (including red highlight for unpaid).

requirements.text: Add a Reports section that includes: (a) daily/monthly sales summary, (b) profit/loss calculation, and (c) tax reports (GST if applicable), computed from stored purchase and sales data.

quotes: 5. yes i want all the additional reports a. Daily/Monthly sales summary b. Profit/loss calculation c. Tax reports (GST if applicable).

acceptanceCriteria: Reports page provides daily and monthly sales totals over selectable date ranges.
Profit/Loss report calculates revenue minus cost of goods sold based on recorded selling prices and purchase costs.
Tax report supports GST totals based on configured per-item (or per-line) GST rates and summarizes taxable value and GST amount over a date range.
All reports are derived from persisted purchases/sales and match underlying records when cross-checked.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor (no multi-canister backend).

Do not edit any files under frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui (compose these components instead).
No external databases or third-party authentication providers; keep all data in-canister.
UPI/Paytm integration must be QR/link-based only (no Paytm API server integration or payment verification assumed).
nonGoals: Integrating external accounting software or exporting to external databases.
Automatic payment confirmation/settlement verification from Paytm/UPI (out of scope unless explicitly added later).
